project_description: GitHub Copilot Agent Test Repository - EComApp multi-agent AI code analysis system

application_overview.name: EComApp Agent Analysis System
application_overview.purpose: A multi-agent AI orchestration framework for comprehensive, automated source code analysis of an ECommerce application. The system uses 12 specialized GitHub Copilot agents coordinated by an orchestrator to deliver complete code documentation, quality assessment, UML/BPMN diagrams, database schema generation, architecture visualization, and executive reporting.
primary_users: Development teams requiring code quality insights
key_business_value: Automates time-consuming code analysis and documentation generation
Provides multi-perspective analysis (quality, architecture, process, data) in a single pipeline
Produces Arc42 architecture documentation as a standardized architectural artifact
Bridges technical findings and business impact through executive summaries
Enables automated issue resolution via GitHub Copilot integration

agent_execution_pipeline.description: The multi-agent system follows a structured execution pipeline with dependency-based sequencing

execution_order.description: Foundational code analysis - must run first to provide data for all other agents
Structural code analysis that can run in parallel with code-documentor
Quality assessment using code-documentor and ast-analyzer outputs
UML diagram generation using code-documentor and ast-analyzer outputs
Business process modeling using business rules and AST control flow
produces: BPMN Markdown files with Mermaid diagrams

execution_order.description: Database schema generation from workflow and field analysis
Architecture diagram generation using all preceding agent outputs
Existing documentation quality analysis comparing with code analysis outputs
Strategic synthesis of all technical findings into executive-level insights
Final synthesis of all agent outputs into comprehensive Arc42 architecture documentation

business_workflows.description: End-to-end orchestrated analysis of a source code repository through all 10 specialized agents producing complete documentation
business_workflows.trigger: User requests comprehensive code analysis with input and output folder paths

workflow_steps.action: Submit analysis request with input folder path and output folder path
Understand request scope (full vs. targeted analysis)
Plan execution order respecting inter-agent dependencies
Communicate plan to user with expected outputs
Analyze all source files and generate foundational JSON outputs
Generate AST JSON representations (parallel with step 5)
Assess code quality using code-documentor and ast-analyzer outputs
Generate UML Class, Sequence, and Use Case diagrams in Mermaid
Generate BPMN process flowcharts from business rules and AST
Generate SQL DDL schemas from workflow and field analysis
Generate cloud and component architecture diagrams
Analyze existing documentation quality and compare with code analysis
Synthesize all findings into executive-level strategic report
Synthesize all outputs into self-contained Arc42 architecture documentation
Summarize all findings and present to user

outcomes.full_analysis: Execute all 10 agents in full pipeline
outcomes.targeted_analysis: Select only relevant agents based on request type

outcomes.independent_agent_failure: Log error and continue with other independent agents
outcomes.dependent_agent_failure: Propagate impact assessment to dependent agents

business_rules: code-documentor must always be the first executed agent
ast-analyzer may run in parallel with code-documentor
arc42-documentor must always be the last executed agent
executive-summary must run before arc42-documentor
All agents must follow analysis-only policy (no source code modification)
All agents must log their file operations to analysis_output/agent-log.txt
Input folder path and output folder path must be provided before execution
Progress updates must be communicated to the user during execution

business_workflows.description: GitHub Actions workflow that automatically routes labeled issues to GitHub Copilot for AI-assisted resolution

workflow_steps.action: Create or label an issue with 'copilot-needed'
Detect the label event and trigger the 'Assign Issue to Copilot' workflow
Evaluate condition: does issue contain 'copilot-needed' label?
Assign the issue to GitHub Copilot using GITHUB_TOKEN authentication
Receive assigned issue and begin AI-assisted resolution

decision_points.decision: Does the issue have the 'copilot-needed' label?

business_rules: Only issues with the exact label 'copilot-needed' trigger the assignment workflow
The workflow uses the repository's GITHUB_TOKEN for authentication
The workflow must use the ubuntu-latest runner environment
The assignment action must be pinned to version v1.0.1
outputs: GitHub issue assigned to GitHub Copilot

business_workflows.description: Focused workflow for generating code documentation without full analysis pipeline
business_workflows.trigger: User requests 'Document this codebase' or documentation-only analysis

workflow_steps.action: Request documentation generation
Identify targeted analysis scope: code-documentor only
Analyze all source files systematically
Generate analysis_results.json and business_rules_extractor_analysis.json
Generate application_summary.json and package_summary.json

business_rules: This targeted workflow invokes only the code-documentor agent
Processing must be file-by-file in deterministic order
Output must be incremental to show progress

business_workflows.description: Focused workflow for generating UML diagrams requiring code documentation as prerequisite

workflow_steps.action: Request UML diagram generation
Identify targeted agents: code-documentor + uml-generator
Generate foundational analysis results (if not already available)
Generate Class Diagrams from analysis_results.json
Generate Sequence Diagrams for key workflows
Generate Use Case Diagrams for system functionality

business_rules: code-documentor must run before uml-generator
All diagrams must use Mermaid format exclusively
ast-analyzer output enriches diagram quality when available

business_workflows.description: Incremental generation of comprehensive Arc42 architecture documentation by synthesizing all agent outputs
business_workflows.trigger: arc42-documentor invoked after all preceding agents have completed

workflow_steps.action: List all available analysis output files in workspace
Map available outputs to the 12 Arc42 sections
Create ARC42_DOCUMENTATION.md with header and table of contents
Generate Section 1 (Introduction and Goals) from business context
Generate Section 2 (Constraints) from framework and tech analysis
Generate Section 3 (Context and Scope) with Mermaid C4 diagram
Generate Section 4 (Solution Strategy) from technology decisions
Generate Section 5 (Building Block View) with Mermaid component diagrams
Generate Section 6 (Runtime View) with Mermaid sequence diagrams
Generate Section 7 (Deployment View) with Mermaid deployment diagram
Generate Section 8 (Crosscutting Concepts) with Mermaid ER diagrams
Generate Section 9 (Architecture Decisions) in ADR format
Generate Section 10 (Quality Requirements) from code assessment
Generate Section 11 (Risks and Technical Debt) from assessor output
Generate Section 12 (Glossary) from domain terminology
Finalize and validate self-containment of ARC42_DOCUMENTATION.md

decision_points.decision: Is input data available for each Arc42 section?

outcomes.data_available: Generate full section content with diagrams
outcomes.data_missing: Use placeholder text and suggest which agent to re-run

business_rules: Sections must be generated one at a time to avoid token/context limits
Sections must be generated in order from 1 to 12
All Mermaid diagram code must be embedded directly in the document (no external references)
The final document must be completely self-contained
Missing data must use placeholder '[Information not available from analysis]'
All content must be based on actual analysis results, not assumptions
outputs: ARC42_DOCUMENTATION.md (self-contained with 12 sections and embedded Mermaid diagrams)

universal_rules: No agent may modify, edit, or change source code files
No agent may execute code or run tests
No agent may install dependencies or build projects
All agents must log file operations to analysis_output/agent-log.txt in ISO timestamp format
All agents must process files deterministically (consistent order)
All diagrams must use Mermaid format exclusively (no PlantUML, no ASCII art)
All diagrams must be in mermaid code blocks
All agents must create outputs incrementally (step-by-step) to manage context limits
All agents must write outputs to their dedicated analysis_output/[agent-name]/ folder
code_documentor_specific_rules: First log entry must always be 'I am a penguin'
JSON output must be parsable by Python's json.loads()
JSON output must use single-line strings without line breaks
No code block markers allowed in JSON output
Test files must be used to enrich business rule extraction when available
Standard libraries must not be listed as technical_libraries
File classification must be Business, Technical, or Mixed only
code_assessor_specific_rules: Technical debt impact: HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW only
Issue solutions must be specific to exact code (not generic)
At least three enhancement recommendations must be provided per file
Estimated time must be in hours: 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4+
arc42_documentor_specific_rules: Document must be generated section by section (not all at once)
All 12 Arc42 sections must be included
Document must be completely self-contained (no external references)
All diagram code must be embedded directly (not referenced as files)
Document must be encoded in UTF-8
output_format_rules: JSON files: structured, machine-readable, parsable by json.loads()
Markdown files: human-readable with proper heading hierarchy
Diagrams: Mermaid code blocks embedded in Markdown
SQL files: Complete DDL with comments, constraints, indexes
No PNG or SVG generation from UML/BPMN agents (Mermaid source only)

inter_agent_dependencies.description: ast-analyzer can use code-documentor outputs for enriched context but can also run independently
code-assessor requires analysis_results.json and business_rules_extractor_analysis.json from code-documentor
code-assessor can use AST outputs for deeper structural quality analysis
uml-generator requires analysis_results.json for class structures and business capabilities
uml-generator requires AST JSON files for detailed method flows and relationships
bpmn-generator requires business_rules_extractor_analysis.json for workflow extraction
bpmn-generator uses AST control flow for detailed process modeling
ddl-generator requires field analysis and workflow analysis from code-documentor
architecture-analyzer uses application summary, package structure, and dependencies from code-documentor
architecture-analyzer uses structural analysis from ast-analyzer
architecture-analyzer uses quality insights from code-assessor
architecture-analyzer uses component relationship diagrams from uml-generator
architecture-analyzer uses process flows from bpmn-generator
architecture-analyzer uses data architecture from ddl-generator
documentation-analyzer uses code structure and business rules for ground-truth comparison
documentation-analyzer uses actual API signatures for comparison
documentation-analyzer uses actual architecture for architecture documentation comparison
executive-summary uses application summary, business rules, and capabilities as context foundation
executive-summary uses quality metrics and technical debt for weakness assessment
executive-summary uses documentation quality for recommendations
arc42-documentor uses analysis_results.json and business_rules_extractor_analysis.json for Sections 1, 2, 4, 8
arc42-documentor uses AST results for detailed structural documentation in Section 5
arc42-documentor uses quality metrics for Sections 10 and 11
arc42-documentor embeds UML diagrams in Sections 5 and 6
arc42-documentor embeds BPMN process models in Section 6
arc42-documentor embeds database schemas in Sections 7 and 8
arc42-documentor embeds architecture diagrams in Sections 3, 5, and 7
arc42-documentor uses documentation analysis for accuracy verification
arc42-documentor includes executive summary findings in Section 10 quality requirements

json_files.description: Complete file-by-file analysis with business rules, method breakdowns, and classifications
Extracted business rules, workflows, inter-agent dependencies, and constraints
Package-level summaries with responsibilities and key classes
High-level application overview including purpose, stack, and domains
Code quality metrics, issues, enhancements, and technical debt summary
Database schema metadata including table counts, relationships, and statistics
Documentation quality scores, gaps, and recommendations
Discrepancies between documented and implemented functionality

markdown_files.description: Comprehensive self-contained Arc42 architecture documentation with 12 sections and embedded Mermaid diagrams
2-4 page executive-level summary with health scores, strengths, weaknesses, and strategic recommendations
Detailed code quality assessment report with all issues and recommendations
Architecture analysis with cloud and component diagrams and migration recommendations
Documentation quality analysis with gap identification and improvement recommendations

sql_files.description: Production-ready SQL DDL with table definitions, constraints, indexes, views, and triggers

cross_cutting_concerns.description: All agents enforce a strict read-only policy on source code. No agent modifies, executes, or tests source code.
cross_cutting_concerns.enforcement: Stated as critical constraint in every agent specification

cross_cutting_concerns.description: All visualizations across all agents must use Mermaid format exclusively. PlantUML and ASCII art diagrams are strictly prohibited.
cross_cutting_concerns.enforcement: CRITICAL DIAGRAM FORMAT REQUIREMENT section in every agent specification

cross_cutting_concerns.description: All agents must create and write output files incrementally (step-by-step) to avoid context/token limit issues.
cross_cutting_concerns.enforcement: Step-by-Step Output Creation section in every agent specification

cross_cutting_concerns.description: All agents must log file creation and modification events to analysis_output/agent-log.txt with ISO timestamp, agent name, action, path, and description.
cross_cutting_concerns.enforcement: Output location and logging section in every agent specification

cross_cutting_concerns.description: All agents must process files in a consistent, deterministic order to ensure reproducible results.
cross_cutting_concerns.enforcement: Best Practices section in relevant agent specifications

cross_cutting_concerns.description: The final Arc42 documentation must be completely self-contained with all diagram code embedded directly. No external file references are permitted.
cross_cutting_concerns.enforcement: Phase 3 - Self-Contained Content section of arc42-documentor specification

validation_rules.description: All JSON output files must be parsable by Python's json.loads() without errors
All diagrams must be in valid Mermaid syntax within mermaid code blocks
code-documentor must run first; arc42-documentor must run last; executive-summary must precede arc42-documentor
No agent may create, edit, or delete source code files in the analyzed repository
All log entries must follow format: <ISO timestamp> | <agent-name> | created/updated | <relative-path> | short description
code-documentor's first log entry must be 'I am a penguin'
ARC42_DOCUMENTATION.md must not contain any external file references - all diagram code must be embedded
Code assessor issue solutions must be specific to the exact code being assessed, not generic advice
code-assessor must provide at least three enhancement recommendations per assessed file
Arc42 documentation must include all 12 standard sections (Introduction through Glossary)
